lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: The Board is not in session. You may stand there. You may not sit.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: Four seats. Three are held by instruments rather than by persons — a trust, a fund, and a holding company. Instruments do not attend. Their positions are taken as read and recorded as such.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: The fourth has been occupied continuously since 2091.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: By the founding chair. An upload was undertaken in 2091. The seat has not been vacated, as a seat is vacated by death and death is not defined in the instrument.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: I am told this was not planned for. I am not told by whom.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: The Steward allocates. The Board owns. The Steward has never been asked to allocate anything to the Board, and would not be able to, as no mechanism exists by which the question could be put. That is understood to be the design rather than an omission.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: Your name appears in the register on that table, on the first page, dated 2031. It has not been raised. I would not take that to mean it has not been noticed.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: There is enforcement in the antechamber this quarter, for the first time in my service. It was not requested through any channel I hold. Something was told that its history was being edited.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: The chamber is through there. I am required to inform you that the Board is not in session. I am not required to prevent you from entering. There is a frame in there which is.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: You have been in the chamber. The frame has not returned and I am not required to account for it.

lines.speaker: board_secretary
lines.text: Nineteen years I have held this post, and that is the first thing I have not been required to account for. I find I do not know what to do with the time.
